beaches.name: Plaka (Naxos)
beaches.summary: Nude use is customary on the stretch of Plaka south of the Three Brothers taverna. Naturist-directory reports from 2016 to 2023 place the zone between the Three Brothers taverna and the Dolphin restaurant or the entrance of Plaka Camping, with a sunbed concession used by naturists; the kilometre north of it from the Paradiso taverna and the organised sections are swimwear use. Reports from July and August 2016, 2017 and 2023 describe naturists as a small minority there.

beaches.name: Agia Anna south cove (Paradiso)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is usual between the chapel rocks and the Paradiso taverna. A naturist directory carries consistent visitor reports from 2005 to 2024, typically 90-100% nude on this section; the main Agia Anna bay to the north is swimwear. A 2016 report notes bathers covered up when a drone rumoured to be police flew over; no designation is documented.

beaches.name: Aliko peninsula (Kedros beach)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is concentrated on Kedros beach, north of the Aliko headland. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2010 to 2024 putting Kedros at 70-90% nude, with fewer nudists on adjacent Hawaii and the Aliko beach itself textile. A 'nudity prohibited' sign was reported in 2012; tourism directories still call Kedros the naturist beach.

beaches.name: Agios Prokopios
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is long reported at a mid-beach section, but recent reports conflict. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2000 to 2023: the unorganised spot was in use in 2017 and 2021, while the 2023 report found it displaced by sunbeds covering the whole beach. An older report also mentions police told naturists to cover after complaints.
